authority: proposed source-backed delivery interpretation;not runtime/build acceptance

frontend_inputs.title: Frontend source and locked dependencies
frontend_inputs.description: Actual build inputs: frontend source including generated API client files, HTML/CSS/logo, installed dependency bytes and reviewed source/license material. Input identity also covers Node version/platform/architecture. Lockfile alone is not a build identity. No dependency installation or build is executed by this modelling task.

frontend_builder.title: Frontend build tooling (development)
frontend_builder.description: Existing Node/esbuild build tooling bundles browser code, copies HTML/CSS/logo/KaTeX fonts and notices, and verifies content-keyed snapshots/dist. Node is a development/build dependency, not a release server. Build output content checks are not test or release acceptance.

frontend_dist.title: Prepared frontend/dist
frontend_dist.description: Existing prepared static tree consumed by Rust build.rs. Current as-read file hashes are an inventory, not proof of freshness or current executable contents. Build writes preview version ending .0; the runtime build overrides its version route. No live directory serving in the released executable.

hpx.native.frontend_assets.embedding.title: Rust asset embedding
hpx.native.frontend_assets.embedding.description: Existing Rust build script requires index.html, sorts traversal, rejects symlinks and generates include_bytes entries. It replaces preview build-version.json with a separately generated four-part build identity and emits assets.rs into OUT_DIR. It does not independently verify frontend input freshness, an asset allowlist or transitive completeness. Existing functionality is bounded; stronger packaging acceptance remains open.

hpx.native.frontend_assets.resources.title: Compiled frontend resources
hpx.native.frontend_assets.resources.description: main.rs includes build-produced assets.rs and resolves an embedded ASSETS map. Runtime serves these compiled bytes, not current frontend/dist or arbitrary filesystem paths. This source model does not inspect/rebuild the executable or attest its actual asset set.

frontend_builder.bundle_code.title: buildFrontend • bundle and copy
frontend_builder.bundle_code.description: Actual esbuild invocation plus explicit copy/write steps for HTML, styles, logo, fonts, legal comments/notices/LICENSE and preview build version. This task does not execute them.

frontend_builder.cache_code.title: Input identity / snapshot / dist helpers
frontend_builder.cache_code.description: Actual hashing/cache helpers: verify source and output digests, build into temporary storage, recheck inputs, rename snapshot entry and conditionally replace dist under a lock. Dist installation is remove/copy/verify, not atomic transactional replacement or authenticated release provenance.

hpx.native.frontend_assets.embedding.bui.title: build.rs • main / walk
hpx.native.frontend_assets.embedding.bui.description: Actual build counter lock/append and version generation precede index existence check and sorted walk. Non-directory non-symlink entries are emitted as include_bytes routes; preview build-version is skipped and replaced. Missing index/symlink/IO failures abort the build; a failed build may consume a build number.

hpx.native.frontend_assets.resources.map.title: include! / ASSETS
hpx.native.frontend_assets.resources.map.description: Actual include!(OUT_DIR/assets.rs) and ASSETS lookup dependency. Generated paths are build outputs rather than new checked-in modules. Exact current binary bytes are outside this read-only modelling check.

hpx.native.transport.assets.delivery_loo.title: route_inner • static GET
hpx.native.transport.assets.delivery_loo.description: Actual non-API GET branch after Host/cross-site validation and before bootstrap/session checks. Root aliases index.html; exact embedded keys only, explicit suffix MIME table and text/plain fallback. Unknown key returns404. Static code/version/license assets require no session or workspace unlock.

hpx.native.transport.responses.delivery_.title: write_response • headers and body
hpx.native.transport.responses.delivery_.description: Actual length, connection close, no-store, nosniff, no-referrer and same-origin CSP headers for shared response path. Static Response has no cookie; bootstrap sets the cookie separately. Policy details remain linked to source, not duplicated as new requirements.

hpx.browser.delivery_entry.title: app.js entry / showBuildVersion
hpx.browser.delivery_entry.description: Browser ES module starts a nonblocking no-store version fetch and awaits initializeRuntime before choosing live/fixture document state. Non-HTTPS initialization returns fixture mode; HTTPS initialization errors rethrow rather than silently falling back. Editor/navigation execute in the browser and are outside delivery decomposition.
